en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a gently sloping market square in a small town surrounded by low hills. Several multi‑storey buildings with steep tiled roofs line the square; one has a small tower or steeple. In the foreground stands a large stone fountain or trough, with a person nearby, and another person is walking across the open square. Printed red text at the top identifies the place as Lauenstein in the Saxon Erzgebirge and the view as the market. Publisher information is printed at the bottom.
